name: Kargath
summary: In the western Badlands, Kargath guards the Horde's foothold. The Kargath Expeditionary Force built the outpost on Warchief Thrall's orders, linking Horde holdings and preparing operations near Uldaman and Blackrock Mountain.

sections.title: A Bastion in Hostile Territory
sections.body: Kargath honors the Shattered Hand chieftain Kargath Bladefist. The outpost is the Horde's only settlement in Khaz Modan, surrounded by arid wastes, dangerous wildlife, and hostile dwarven factions. Its garrison gives travelers a refuge midway across the continent. From here, a flight master connects northern holdings such as the Undercity and Hammerfall with southern outposts such as Stonard and Grom'gol Base Camp.

sections.title: The Expeditionary Mission
sections.body: Warchief Thrall sent the Kargath Expeditionary Force to pursue two aims. Troops enter Uldaman's ancient titan halls to learn why Ironforge's Prospectors value the dig site so highly. Scouts also seek a route through the Searing Gorge into Blackrock Mountain. There they hope to strike Rend Blackhand's false 'Dark Horde' while facing the entrenched Dark Iron dwarves.

faq.q: Why is this Horde town out in the middle of the Badlands?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall ordered the Kargath Expeditionary Force to establish the outpost and secure a foothold in the region. The force investigates the dwarven dig at Uldaman and seeks a route into Blackrock Mountain to strike the Dark Horde.
Kargath honors Kargath Bladefist, the famed chieftain of the Shattered Hand orc clan.

faq.q: Why are the flight routes from Kargath so important?
faq.answer: Kargath links northern Horde holdings such as the Undercity and Hammerfall with southern territories in Stranglethorn Vale and the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: What threat is the garrison at Kargath preparing to fight?
faq.answer: The garrison faces local Dark Iron dwarves and investigates Ironforge's presence at Uldaman. It also prepares to strike Rend Blackhand and his Dark Horde in Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: Kargath is the Horde's only friendly fortress in Khaz Modan, with supplies, flight connections, and a base for strikes against Blackrock Mountain.
As an orc, you see Kargath bear your chieftain Kargath Bladefist's name. Thrall's campaign from this outpost aims to destroy Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde.
